headline: One game tonight, TB @ DAL. Four selections cleared the price bar; two were cut on role and game script, leaving two small Dallas props for 2 units.

games.note: Two plays (Goodson TD, Flournoy receptions over). Game lines are tight: best side was TB ML at -1.0%. Ted Hurst TD showed +13% and Gainwell under 1.5 receptions +4.4%; both cut, see passed.

picks.subject: Tyler Goodson
picks.label: Tyler Goodson anytime TD
picks.reason: Dallas waived Emari Demercado this afternoon, leaving Goodson as the only back behind Javonte Williams on an 8.5-point home favorite; he practiced in full all week and is active, and DraftKings' +700 is longer than Pinnacle's fair +649.

picks.subject: Ryan Flournoy
picks.label: Ryan Flournoy over 3.5 receptions
picks.reason: Dallas' full-time slot receiver (about 75% of routes, 5+ targets in three of four games, 4 and 5 catches in two of them) against a Tampa secondary missing CB Benjamin Morrison and S Antoine Winfield Jr.; +128 is longer than Pinnacle's +121 at the same number. Thin edge: it only just clears the 3% bar and the other US books price it nearer fair.

passed.label: Ted Hurst III anytime TD +600 (+13.2%)
passed.why: Edge over 10% with no news that makes DraftKings the stale book: his route share fell to a season-low 47% last week with Tez Johnson out-snapping him early, and an undrafted rookie QB is starting again.

passed.label: Kenny Gainwell under 1.5 receptions +145 (+4.4%)
passed.why: He has 1, 3, 2 and 2 catches in four games, drew the only running back targets last week, and Tampa is an 8.5-point underdog with a rookie QB, which is a script for the passing-down back; the other books also price the under shorter than Pinnacle.

passed.label: Sean Tucker anytime TD +400 (+1.3%)
passed.why: Below the 5% bar for touchdown props.

notes: Card built about 65 minutes before kickoff, after the official inactives: Baker Mayfield is out (Jalon Daniels starts), and nobody on the card is affected.
No parlay: legs must come from different games and there is only one game tonight.
